headline: North Korean hackers steal hundreds of millions from Bitget
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget disclosed that suspected North Korean hackers stole funds from its hot and warm wallets, in what TechCrunch calls the largest crypto theft so far this year. Outlets differ on the exact amount stolen, reporting figures of $351.6 million, $351 million, and $387.5 million.
